title: ElasticRec: A Microservice-based Model Serving Architecture Enabling Elastic Resource Scaling for Recommendation Models
problem: Current RecSys model serving architectures use model-wise resource allocation which falls short in effective resource utilization. The heterogeneous resource demands of recommendation models result in sub-optimal total cost of ownership.
motivation: Recommendation systems demand increasingly large compute resources in data centers, making efficient resource allocation critical for cost optimization.
method: ElasticRec employs a microservice-based software architecture enabling fine-grained resource allocation tailored to recommendation system heterogeneous demands. It implements utility-based resource allocation to achieve high memory efficiency. The architecture enables elastic scaling by decomposing model serving to allow independent component scaling.
key_novelty: Applying microservice-based architecture with utility-based resource allocation specifically for recommendation system inference serving.
contributions: Microservice-based model serving architecture for RecSys with fine-grained resource allocation
Utility-based resource allocation mechanism for memory efficiency
Elastic resource scaling capabilities for recommendation models
3.3x memory allocation reduction and 1.6x deployment cost reduction

metrics.other: 3.3x memory allocation reduction, 8.1x memory utility increase, 1.6x deployment cost reduction

primary_theme: Microservice-based elastic resource allocation for recommendation inference
